description:
FILED s517a (Opus, 2026-10-16) -- newly REACHED by #3262 (Capture::Tiny's
tmpfile seek now works, so 02-capture 03-tee 08-stdin-closed 12-stdin-string
run past row 1; 236 board rows carry this cause).

    use Capture::Tiny qw(capture);
    my ($o, $e) = capture { binmode(STDOUT, q{:utf8}); binmode(STDERR, q{:utf8});
                            print "STDOUT:Hi! \x{263a}\n"; print STDERR "STDERR:Hi! \x{263a}\n" };
    # ords of $o
    perl 5.40.3: 53 54 44 4f 55 54 3a 48 69 21 20 263a a   (CHARACTERS: the
                 captured STDOUT is read back through the handle's :utf8 layer)
    PCL:         ... 20 e2 98 ba a                          (UTF-8 BYTES)
    ($e is bytes in both: perl reads STDERR's capture without the layer.)

scratch/s517a/pr/ct.pl.  Capture::Tiny reads PerlIO::get_layers(*STDOUT) and
re-applies them to the capture file (_relayer / _copy_std); PCL's answer to
get_layers or its binmode on the reopened tmpfile handle loses the :utf8.
Probe get_layers on a :utf8 STDOUT first.
subject: Capture::Tiny: a captured STDOUT under a :utf8 layer comes back as UTF-8 bytes; perl decodes it (236 board rows newly reached by #3262)
